第25章你女儿没有男朋友
读书？
那一刻，秦芬不知道想到了什么，看向林熙的目光满是怜惜。
多好的孩子啊，什么都不要，只想要一个读书的机会。
结合着林熙瘦弱的外在，一个家境贫寒却又力求上进，对知识充满渴望的形象瞬间浮现在了秦芬脑海中。
秦芬想都没想便答应了，掷地有声道：“放心，这件事情我一定帮大师你办好！”
“那大师，到时候我把你安排在初一，你看合适吗？”
她之前看很多新闻，知道一些偏僻山区的孩子可能一生都没有读书的机会，有的好一点，或许能读完希望小学，但几乎很少有念过初中的。
就林熙这样的情况看，她恐怕正是后者，
所以秦奋觉得她可以从初中开始念，年纪大点没关系，至少林熙长得像初中生啊。
结果她这话一出，便得到林熙一个疑惑中带着几分怀疑的眼神。
“我该上高三了，为什么还要重新念初中？”
秦芬该不会是故意坑自己吧。
读书那么累，她可不想再多念五年。
秦芬：“啊，啊？”
最后一番沟通之后，秦芬才知道原来林熙在老家的日子过得没有她想象中那么惨，至少书是读了的，就是她现在转学去江渝那边的事情没落实，手续繁琐且她没有门道，才会让秦芬帮忙。
秦芬抹了一把汗水，尴尬的笑了笑。
“哈哈，原来是这。”
她绝对不会告诉林熙刚刚她脑补了一出什么。
转学这件事情对于林熙来说有点麻烦，但对于认识很多人的秦芬来说并不是问题。

她恰好有朋友在江渝市教育系统里，于是当即便和那边的朋友联系，对方表示会尽快将这件事情搞定，甚至为了林熙上学方便，对方还贴心的问了林熙的住址。
挂断电话，秦芬立刻跟林熙说了这件事情。
林熙点头，随后道了句谢。
眼见这边的事情都处理完了，她便打算回去了。
不过还没走，小胡警官便急忙来到了医院，兴奋的告诉王警官，这次的案件侦破了！
那男人在巷子不远处被他们抓到，并且神奇的是，抓到的时候男人像是经受了无尽的折磨似的，明知道他们是来抓他的，却哭着朝他们爬过来，还喊救命。
小胡警官几人一脸懵逼，四处看了看，分明除了那男人之外一个人都没有。
最终其余人只当这人是疯了，但是小胡警官却莫名想到了在地窖的时候林熙对虚空说的那番话，说什么下手轻点。
莫非真的是那个被男人害死的姑娘回来找他报仇了？
但不管如何，证据确凿，男人又抓到了，只等之后判刑就可以了。
他这种犯罪手段极为残忍，影响也相当恶劣的，不出意外的话恐怕要吃花生米了。
“哦对了，林熙同志，这次多亏了你的帮忙，局里决定给你颁发协助奖，会有证书和奖金，你留个地址，到时候我们亲自给你送上门。”
不得不说，如果这次没有林熙帮忙的话，他们或许还真的不一定能抓到凶手，特别是那障眼法，他们恐怕一辈子都破不了。
所以在回局里跟上级汇报的时候，小胡警官一五一十的把这些事情都跟组长说了，组长也受到了极大的震撼。
然后组长把这事告诉了副局，副局却像是知道什么似的，沉思片刻，忽然叮嘱他记下林熙的联系方式，并在规矩范围内尽可能的给她最高的奖励。
林熙当然不知道这些，她将自己的具体住址告诉了小胡警官之后，便被他们送去了机场。

Chapter 25 Your daughter has no boyfriend
Reading?
At that moment, Qin Fen didn't know what she was thinking of, and looked at Lin Xi with eyes full of pity.
What a good kid, he wants nothing but a chance to study.
Combined with Lin Xi's thin appearance, the image of a person from a poor family who strives to make progress and is full of desire for knowledge instantly appeared in Qin Fen's mind.
Qin Fen agreed without thinking, and said loudly: "Don't worry, I will definitely help you handle this matter, Master!"
"Then Master, I will place you in the first grade of junior high school. Do you think it is suitable?"
She had read a lot of news before and knew that some children in remote mountainous areas may never have the opportunity to study in their lives. Some are better off and may be able to complete Hope Primary School, but few have ever completed junior high school.
Judging from Lin Xi's situation, she is probably the latter.
So Qin Fen thought she could start studying in junior high school. It didn't matter if she was older, at least Lin Xi looked like a junior high school student.
As a result, as soon as she said these words, she received a confused and somewhat suspicious look from Lin Xi.
"It's time for me to enter my senior year of high school, why should I go to junior high school again?"
Could it be that Qin Fen deliberately tricked herself?
Studying was so tiring, and she didn't want to study for five more years.
Qin Fen: "Ah, ah?"
After the last communication, Qin Fen found out that Lin Xi's life in her hometown was not as miserable as she imagined. At least she had read the books. It was because her transfer to Jiang Yu had not been implemented, the procedures were cumbersome and she had no connections, that she asked Qin Fen to help.
Qin Fen wiped her sweat and smiled awkwardly.
"Haha, so this is it."
She would never tell Lin Xi what she had just imagined.
The matter of transferring schools was a bit troublesome for Lin Xi, but it was not a problem for Qin Fen, who knew many people.
She happened to have a friend in the Jiangyu City education system, so when she contacted her friend there, the other party said that they would settle the matter as soon as possible. In order to make it easier for Lin Xi to go to school, the other party even thoughtfully asked for Lin Xi's address.
After hanging up the phone, Qin Fen immediately told Lin Xi about the matter.
Lin Xi nodded and then said thank you.
Seeing that everything here was settled, she planned to go back.
But before leaving, Officer Xiao Hu hurried to the hospital and excitedly told Officer Wang that this case was solved!
The man was caught by them not far from the alley, and the amazing thing was that when he was caught, the man seemed to have endured endless torture. He knew they were here to catch him, but he crawled toward them crying and shouted for help.
Officer Xiao Hu and others looked confused and looked around. It was clear that there was no one except the man.
In the end, the others just thought that this man was crazy, but Officer Xiao Hu inexplicably thought of what Lin Xi said to Vukong in the cellar, about being gentle.
Could it be that the girl who was killed by the man came back to seek revenge on him?
But no matter what, the evidence is conclusive and the man has been caught again. He just needs to wait for the sentence later.
His criminal methods are extremely cruel and the impact is quite bad. If nothing else happens, he may have to eat peanuts.
"Oh, by the way, Comrade Lin Xi, thanks to your help this time, the bureau has decided to award you an assistance award. There will be a certificate and a bonus. Please leave your address and we will deliver it to you personally."
It has to be said that without Lin Xi's help this time, they might not be able to catch the murderer, especially the blindness, which they might not be able to break in their lifetime.
So when he returned to the station to report to his superiors, Officer Xiao Hu told the team leader all these things in detail, and the team leader was also greatly shocked.
Then the team leader told the deputy bureau about this, but the deputy bureau seemed to know something. He pondered for a moment and suddenly told him to write down Lin Xi's contact information and give her the highest reward possible within the rules.
Lin Xi of courseNot knowing this, she told Officer Xiao Hu her specific address and was taken to the airport by them.
